text:
Marta Gomez: Quick check for tomorrow's leadflow blog + webinar landing - need a compact SEO ops list: canonical decision, five internal link targets, redirect fallbacks for old promo URLs, and a small JSON-LD snippet for the event. Can we lock owners? @Jon @Priya @Suresh

Jon R.: I'll do the crawl and list top 5 inbound pages. ETA 20m. Will also add anchor-text suggestions.

Priya Patel: I'll prepare Event JSON-LD + FAQ block. Minimal Event example below and I'll drop the full snippet in /docs/seo/snippets.
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Leadflow demo","startDate":"2026-08-12T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/leadflow"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register/leadflow"}}
```

Suresh Iyer: Redirects: legacy paths like /promo/lead-june and partner variants with ?ref=partner. Plan: edge strip utm_* and then 302 in staging, 301 in prod. Quick nginx test rule: `rewrite ^/promo/lead-june/?$ /product/leadflow? redirect;`

Marta Gomez: Canonical rule: prefer /product/leadflow. Partner clones should use rel=canonical to that URL unless content is >30% unique.

Jon R.: Crawl done. Top inbound targets: /docs/getting-started (anchor: "set up inbound lead routing"), /integrations ("Leadflow integrations"), /partners ("partner lead routing"), /support/routing ("routing rules"), /pricing ("Leadflow pricing"). I'll populate the internal-link sheet and assign owners.

Priya Patel: I'll A/B FAQ visibility (collapsed vs inline) for 14 days and monitor impressions. Snippets saved to /docs/seo/snippets and linked in the PR.

Suresh Iyer: I'll push redirect PR to staging, run smoke tests, and watch for any 301 loops. If green, we'll flip to permanent before morning.

Marta Gomez: Perfect. Priority for tonight: redirects, JSON-LD, internal links, canonical headers, sitemap ping. Postlaunch checks at +2h and +24h. Thanks team :rocket:
